title: Universal linear manipulation via routing and projective measurements
summary: Multiport interferometers with $N$ ports are basic devices in both classical and quantum photonics. Ideally, they implement a linear unitary transformation between the input and output electric field vectors with $N$ components, each associated with a spatial mode of classical coherent light or a single photon. Standard designs for a fully reconfigurable universal multiport interferometer are given by the Reck or the Clements schemes.
